The[b]
v0[b]
Subset[b]
A
tiny,
fixed[b]
subset
of
HTML
and
CSS,
rendered
by
the
native[i]
T0
path.
What[b]
it[b]
covers[b]
Block
and
inline
flow
over
a
handful
of
elements:
headings,
paragraphs,
lists,
and
inline
emphasis
such
as
bold[b]
,
italic[i]
,
and
links[u]
.
Everything[i]
outside[i]
the[i]
allowlist[i]
is[i]
dropped,[i]
not[i]
rendered.[i]
